lines.text: Jerusalem drained the cup of the LORD's fury to the dregs, and no son guided her.
The LORD removed the cup of staggering from Jerusalem and will place it in the hands of her watchmen.
Zion is told to put on garments of splendor, and the LORD says she will be redeemed without money.
God's people first went down to Babylon to live, then Assyria oppressed them without cause.
Those who carry the vessels of the LORD will not leave in haste, for the LORD goes before them.
